_comment: Annual events whose own site states the date only in a sentence, read by mapsee_ingest_annual.py. Identity, venue and coordinates are curated here; the DATE, the clock and the publisher's own FREE sentence are read from the site on every run and never stored, as fair_sources.json does. shape 'day': the site is the event's own, single days count, and name_rx is required and names the EVENT, not the organiser ('short\s+run\s+comix', not 'short\s+run': every post on an organiser's homepage says its name, and the nearest named date wins); a date is believed only with that name within 90 characters before it, never across another date, or in its own paragraph. shape 'range': ranges only, as the fairs adapter. 'months' (optional) is the event's own months and 'weekdays' (optional, day names) the weekdays its editions start on, curated from its past editions: a date starting outside them is never the event, whatever words surround it, and a date inside them still needs the name and no deny word; '_months' says where they came from. 'pages' (optional) are read in order only while the homepage has given nothing upcoming and has not said the edition's own hours ended today; no other link is followed. The venue is re-checked against the publisher each edition: it is curated, not scraped.

sites.name: Short Run Comix Festival
sites._months: Five editions on the saved homepage (read 2026-11-07), each a Saturday in Nov 1-7, the first Saturday of November: 2026-11-07 (the hero), 2025-11-01 ('Saturday, Nov. 1st', post of 2025-09-20), 2024-11-02 ('Nov. 2nd', post of 2024-08-27), 2023-11-04 ('Nov. 4th', post of 2023-09-11) and 2022-11-05 ('Nov. 5th', post of 2022-09-14). No edition in any other month or on any other weekday. No margin: [10, 11] let a 'Halloween zine swap: Saturday, October 30th, 2027' and an 'exhibitor lottery results: Monday, October 4th, 2027' through as the 2027 festival (review, 2026-11-20). A date outside November or not a Saturday is never the festival, whatever words surround it (exhibitor applications, anthology submissions, a Spring Market, a volunteer orientation the Saturday before). An edition moved to October or to another weekday reads as none, and the run's line says 'outside the event's months' or 'not the event's weekday': widen this then, from the publisher's own date.
